commonDocumentNote: Indicative only. The official notice decides which documents are required for a given drive.
dataRules: Every drive must have a unique id and slug; jobIds, courseIds, stateIds, requiredDocumentIds, corrigendumIds and supersedesId must reference existing records.
Publish only from the recruiting body's official notice; noticeUrl or officialUrl is required, and noticeNumber must be copied exactly when present.
Never invent vacancies, posts, pay levels, age limits, fees, dates, helpdesk details or links; use null when unknown.
totalVacancies must be as published; do not compute or round it.
applicationEnd must not precede applicationStart; stage dates must be consistent with the notice; dates use YYYY-MM-DD or null.
When a corrigendum, extension or revised schedule is issued, create a record with supersedesId and mark the earlier record outdated rather than silently editing.
Closed or expired drives must be reviewed before display, and must not appear as open.
Show the official application channel only; never link to third parties who offer to 'guarantee' selection or charge to apply.
Application fees must be shown exactly as published with currency and exemptions; never imply a fee is required unless the notice says so.
Age limits and eligibility must be quoted from the notice, with asOnDate where stated; never infer eligibility.
Reservation and category rules must be stated only as published, without interpretation.
Do not publish personal data of candidates or officials beyond official helpdesk contacts printed in the notice.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together; 'verified' requires noticeUrl or sourceUrl.
The active field controls display only; it does not mean applications are open.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm this recruitment with the official notice.
displayRules.scamWarning: Genuine recruitment never requires payment to 'secure' a job. Apply only through the official channel named in the notice.
displayRules.disclaimer: Recruitment details are informational and can change. MedOrbits does not recruit, guarantee selection, or replace the official notice.
